graph.note: Obtained from MSBuild's structured -getItem/-getProperty JSON. A host without a trusted evaluation cannot construct this, and a compilation without it reports every framework type as missing — which is why local semantic diagnostics are gated on graph delivery and not on the Roslyn payload alone.

unmeasured.what: Cold start and peak resident memory of the semantic service on an Android device.
unmeasured.why: Needs a physical device or emulator running the composed host. Not available on the recording machine, and a desktop figure is not a substitute — the JIT, the memory ceiling, and the storage are all different.

unmeasured.what: Installed size delta of an APK that embeds the Roslyn assemblies, trimmed and untrimmed.
unmeasured.why: Measurable here in principle; recorded as owed because trimming Roslyn requires a reflection-safety review that Phase 0 has not done, and an untrimmed number quoted as a trimmed one would be misleading.

unmeasured.what: Browser cold start and peak heap for the trimmed interpreted profile with Roslyn composed.
unmeasured.why: Needs a browser harness driving the published profile. The published payload size is measurable without one and is recorded separately by the payload probe script.

unmeasured.what: AOT profile measurements with Roslyn composed.
unmeasured.why: Deliberately not measured. Phase 0's instruction is to measure AOT only if that IDE host mode will be claimed, and no such claim is being made.
